changeSet.author: hms
changeSet.comment:
Consultation addenda.
Needed because Visit.consultation is one-to-one, so a second Consultation row for the same visit is impossible by construction — there is nowhere else to put a note that must not overwrite the original. A consultation that has been completed cannot be edited at all, so further clinical comment is appended here instead.
Not part of the JDL model: JDL generation would overwrite the hand-written service that enforces the correction rule, and this entity only exists to serve it.

changeSet.author: hms
changeSet.comment:
Seed the general-consultation catalogue entry, so completing a consultation has a price to charge out of the box.
The id is an explicit value in a reserved high band rather than a call to sequence_generator. That sequence is shared with every entity and consumed by Hibernate's own allocator, which hands out blocks of 50; taking a value from it here could collide with a block Hibernate is already holding. An explicit id in a band no entity table will reach is the same approach JHipster's own sample data takes.
PRICE IS ZERO ON PURPOSE. The consultation fee is a commercial decision, not something to be invented in a migration. Zero means a dev consultation bills nothing until someone sets the real fee — edit this catalogue row (or the seed) to the real amount. The application treats a zero price as a legitimate configuration, so it will not complain.
Idempotent: the WHERE NOT EXISTS means re-running against a database that already has a CONSULTATION entry leaves it alone, including any price that was set in the meantime.
